_doc: SEED-ONLY since 2026-09-26. The source of truth is the entity registry: each subject lives on its entity as `product_radar` (entity_registry.set_product_radar / list_product_radar_subjects), and cpo_radar.load_subjects() reads it from there. This file is used only to (re)seed (`python -m src.ingest.cpo_radar --seed-registry`), for tests, and as a loud fallback when the registry is unreachable or empty (the output then reports subjects_source=seed_fallback). Origin: #158 spike subjects (iTunes search API country=br; YouTube channels.list forHandle, 2026-09-26). onca_entities[0] is the entity a subject lives on; the rest become related_entities. BCB fee-table CNPJs are deliberately not here (pricing lens).

products.name: Nubank
products.namesake_risk: 'Nu' alone is too short; never match bare 'nu'.

products.name: Inter
products.namesake_risk: 'Inter' collides with Internacional (football), 'inter' prefix words. Require 'Banco Inter'/'Inter&Co' or channel/app context.

products.name: Mercado Pago
products.namesake_risk: Mercado Livre marketplace news mentions Mercado Pago in passing; the @mercadopago channel is Argentina (Spanish) - use the BR channel. Spanish-language MX/AR creator videos are out of scope.

products.name: C6 Bank
products.namesake_risk: Bare 'C6' collides with cars/chemistry; require 'C6 Bank'/'Banco C6'. Zero-subscriber look-alike channels exist (impersonation is a separate CRO/CISO issue) - only the listed channel id is official.
